title: Steffi B Possible NDE 8705
content: I was going through a depression due to the events in my life. I tried to help myself by engaging myself in parties, get togethers, and even travelling. But everything seemed to be just temporary. I was happy for the moment, but later would return back to my depression. Every night I use to pray and cry bitterly for help, as I felt that my mind had stopped working and there is no sense of living my life. I didn't even knew what to pray for. I would just go to church or sit at home seeking help from the Almighty and just cry. I wanted to help myself but I was helpless. I was continuously seeking for someone who could pull me out, but I felt that no one could understand this condition of mine and would not believe me. Days and months passed by and I continued surviving. One day I got a interview call from a company situated in Gurgaon (India). I was living in Bhopal at the time. I thought that relocating myself to a new place with a new job can be the perfect way of getting out of depression. I booked my tickets and reached Delhi. The next morning was my interview. I woke up with the expectation of a new life ahead. I booked my cab and reached Gurgaon. I asked the cab-driver to drop me near to the company where my interview was scheduled. Thanking him I got down from the cab. It was 8:30 a.m. and my interview was scheduled for 9:30 a.m. I arrived early, so stayed outside the building. I wanted to get some coffee, but didn't see a coffee shop nearby. However, I could see a mall on the other side of the highway. As it was early morning and the highway was clear, I crossed the road. The mall was closed. I had no option left. I needed to get back to the company, so I chose to cross the highway again. Before crossing the road, I clearly remember that I promised myself to leave my past life in Bhopal to begin a fresh new life after taking this job. I will not look back at people who didn't loved me. With this thought while crossing the highway, a vehicle hit me. I went unconscious while I bounced off the windshield and onto the road. Although I was unconscious during the entire process, the driver told me what happened to me after my treatment. As I fell on the road, the other vehicle dove over me and I got stuck under the tire. My head was injured and bleeding, my shoulder was fractured, and the left leg was completely smashed. The driver of the vehicle managed to take my body out of the tire. He had great difficulty trying to get my body into his car so that he could take me to the hospital. As he was driving me to the hospital, I opened my eyes for some seconds and saw the car. I was completely painless. I again fell unconscious and saw the entire process which as it was going to happen now. Some unknown voice told me, 'You knew all this is going to happen and you still chose to come here.' The next time I opened my eyes, I was in the hospital. The driver was pleading to the doctor to save me somehow. At that moment, I felt enormous pain for the first time after the accident and started screaming. Although the treatment was a long procedure, the experience I had on my way to the hospital can't be explained in words. I don't know if this was a NDE but surely unnatural. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 15.06.2016 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident Other: I had the experience on the way to the hospital after the accident. I can't judge if that was life threatening or not since I was unconscious. How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Uncertain. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. I was depressed At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was not conscious Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. it was so fast. I was shown my past, present, and future at the exact same time. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There was no verbal voice. I was just experiencing what the voice was trying to tell me Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes the vision of what is going to happen next. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? blank Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future. I saw that I already knew that the accident is going to happen and that I was being rushed to the hospital Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian Although I was and am a Christian, I always believed that all religion preaches love and I can never discriminate anyone on the basis of religion. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I now concentrate more on spirituality rather than being religious. What is your religion now? I would like to consider myself as spiritual and not religious. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I felt that everything is for a purpose Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain it showed me that I already knew this is going to happen During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I started realizing that nothing should be attached to you. I started knowing the concept of detachment. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I don't know from where the voice was speaking to me and the vision I had can't be explained. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Yes but not ready to disclose. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes After I got treated I shared the experience to only handful of people because I knew not everyone could understand this. It happened in 2016 and I shared with only 1 or 2 people at that moment. Now in 2018, I have shared this with a group of people who are into spirituality. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. During the treatment, I was amazed and shocked with my vision. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. Now I know that such visions do happen to people who have experienced NDE, so I definitely know it was real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Flash of past, present, and personal future at the same time; unidentifiable voice conveyed: 'You knew all this is going to happen and you still chose to come here.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience described occurring while unconscious en route to hospital: rapid simultaneous past/present/future vision with an unidentifiable voice; no tunnel, beings, light, or other-world environment reported.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Past, present, and future were shown 'at the exact same time.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experiencer reports being shown past, present, and personal future simultaneously, including knowledge that the accident would happen and that they would be rushed to the hospital; communication described as nonverbal understanding rather than hearing a spoken voice.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “You knew all this is going to happen and you still chose to come here.”; “I was shown my past, present, and future at the exact same time.”
